units: <cite ref="Chullin 65a:5">Ḥull. 65ᵃ</cite> <he>ש׳ עם הטמאים טמא</he> a bird (of which you do not know whether it is clean or unclean) that nests with unclean birds, is unclean.

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 92b:13">B. Kam. 92ᵇ</cite> (quot. from an unknown writing, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7) <he>כל עוף למינו יִשְׁכּוֹן וכ׳</he> every bird nests with its kind, and man with his like; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Torah 116">Yalk. Gen. 116</cite>; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 67">Yalk. Jud. 67</cite>. Tanḥ. Noah 15 <he>אין הקללה שׁוֹכֶנֶת וכ׳</he> (<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 36:8">Gen. R. s. 36</cite> <he>הוָֹה</he>) curse does not rest (take effect) where blessing has been pronounced; a. fr.
<cite ref="Berakhot 12a:9">Ber. 12ᵃ</cite> <he>מי שש׳ את שמו הוא יַשְׁכִּין וכ׳</he> may he who caused his name to dwell in this house, let dwell among you love and brotherhood &c.

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 64:3">Gen. R. s. 64</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="U01174"><he>שְׁכֹן</he></cite>, <cite ref="Genesis 26:2">Gen. XXVI, 2</cite>) <he>שׁכֵּן השכינה בארץ</he> let the Shechinah rest in the land (do not cause the Shechinah to move with thee to a foreign land); Yalk. ib. 111.
Pirké d’R. El. ch. XXXVI איני יכול לשַׁכֵּן שכינתי עליך וכ׳ I cannot let my Shechinah (holy inspiration) rest upon thee in a foreign land; a. fr.—2) to make prosperous.
Num. R. s. 143 שבשבילו ש׳ ה׳ לאדוניו because for his (Joseph’s) sake the Lord prospered his master; [Matt. K.; the Lord revealed himself to his master, v.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 86">Gen. R. s. 86</cite>, end].—[<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 34">Gen. R. s. 34</cite> <he>שיכן בזכות</he>, v. <cite ref="U00920"><he>שִׁיכּוּן</he></cite>.]

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 5:1:1">Cant. R. to V, 1</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Psalms 37:29">Ps. XXXVII, 29</cite>) <he>יַשְׁכִּינוּ לשכינה וכ׳</he> they cause the Shechinah to dwell on earth; <cite ref="Psalms 37:29">ib.</cite> <he>הצדיקים הִשְׁכִּינוּ וכ׳</he> the righteous (Abraham, Isaac etc.) brought the Shechinah down to earth.
